description: This file contains shell script code designed to test the behavior of 'git svn' operations, particularly focusing on empty directories, their creation, deletion, and synchronization between SVN and Git repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if the given path is a directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if the given path is missing (does not exist).
